items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I had a lawyer in New York, a West Indian lawyer, and he started fooling with the deposits when they come in.

ctx.x: And in my management, started to mess it up because I had a lawyer in New York, a West Indian lawyer, and he started fooling with the deposits when they come in. He took $2,000 of the money and went out and bought him -- put it down and bought him a home with that.
